title: Sheaf sum-adjunction fold counit and ordinary scalar extension
statement:
Let $e:U\to V$ be a separated etale morphism of finite type of schemes, and let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital map of commutative rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Work with ordinary constant-ring module sheaves on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Write $S_R=e_{\Sigma!,R}$ for sheafified sum extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension], and $e_R^*$ for exact constant-coefficient inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. For $R=A,B$ there is a sheaf adjunction $S_R\dashv e_R^*$ whose bijection sends a morphism $S_RH\to F$ to the compatible family of maps $H(W,s)\to F(W)$ on etale test objects $W\to V$ and lifts $s:W\to U$ over $V$. Its counit $v^0_{R,F}:S_Re_R^*F\to F$ is induced by the fold $\bigoplus_sF(W)\to F(W)$, sending each $i_s(x)$ to $x$, under the restriction identification [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction].
Use ordinary sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and write $F_B=F\otimes_{A_V}B_V$. Let $a_F^0:(e_A^*F)\otimes_{A_U}B_U\xrightarrow{\sim}e_B^*(F_B)$ be ordinary scalar/pullback reassociation and let $\rho_H:(S_AH)\otimes_{A_V}B_V\to S_B(H\otimes_{A_U}B_U)$ be induced locally by $i_s(x)\otimes b\mapsto i_s(x\otimes b|_{(W,s)})$, using sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. For every $A_V$-module sheaf $F$,
$$v^0_{B,F_B}\circ S_B(a_F^0)\circ\rho_{e_A^*F}=v^0_{A,F}\otimes1_B.$$
These are natural $B_V$-linear sheaf maps. For a cochain complex $P$ on $V$, applying them in every degree yields equal $B_V$-linear chain maps $(S_Ae_A^*P)\otimes_A B\to P\otimes_A B$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. No flatness, boundedness, constructibility, or finiteness of the rings is assumed.

proof.text: Use the existing etaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction. Transport its homEquiv through upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction, evaluate on a test W and x, and expand the sheafified left Kan-extension unit. This gives exactly the summand formula of etaleSheafSumFold. Evaluate it on the counit: the right triangle identity and the inverse/hom identity of the restriction isomorphism give the fold formula. Reuse the proved private etaleLiftSection_iso and projection_sum_unit from EtaleProjectionSectionNormalization through a proof-only import all; do not duplicate these statements in the item module.

Construct etaleSumScalarIso by uniqueness of left adjoints for the two composite sum/scalar adjunctions, transporting the second right adjoint along upperStarRestrictScalarsIsoSheaf.symm. Apply lem-sp-etale-scalar-section-normalization to obtain the two required local pure-tensor formulas for this fixed comparison.

The proved generic private scalarOpenInverseMate identifies the inverse sum/scalar comparison with the iterated inverse mate of the restriction/scalar square. The proved private ordinary_reverse_eq identifies its first inverse mate with the specified scalarSheafPullbackIso.inv. These helpers are reused from the source modules, without using their holed public theorems. Apply mateEquiv_counit_symm to the sum adjunctions and precompose with etaleSumScalarIso.hom. Cancel its hom/inv pair. Expanding the functor associators and unitors is precisely etaleScalarReassociatedFold = etaleScalarExtendedFold.

Choose rho to be the hom of etaleSumScalarIso. Combine its local normalization formulas with the proved fold-counit equality. Apply congrArg to mapHomologicalComplex and evaluate at P for the actual cochain identity; no further construction, boundedness, or flatness is needed.
